## About
Elite Auto Werks Collision Center is a collision repair shop on Skillman Street in Dallas. Our goal is simple: restore your vehicle to its pre-collision state and treat you well while we do it.
We know accidents are stressful. Our technicians work closely with our front office so you have people to talk to from drop off to pick up.
Drivers have given us a 4.9 rating from 457 Google reviews. Stop by, call, or send us your year, make and model and tell us how we can help.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body work to bring your vehicle back to the way it was before the accident.
- Wheel repair: Repair for damaged wheels so they roll smoothly and look their best again.
- Wheel alignments: Alignment service to help with handling, tire wear and overall safety.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free quotes?
A: Yes. Contact us to schedule an appointment or to get your free quote.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we have Saturday hours. We are closed on Sunday.

Q: Can I bring my car in for an insurance claim repair?
A: One reviewer told us he has brought his cars to us for insurance claim repairs more than once. Give us a call to talk through your claim.
